answer: Stake-backed identity with slashing is the defense: each agent locks a bond in a common harbor before its vote counts. The coordinator sends every registered key a private whisper nonce that only that key can sign, and a commitment published ahead of time lets auditors spot any plume of clones at review. A Sybil farmer must post a separate deposit for each fake identity, and caught duplicates forfeit the whole stake, so growing the attack grows the loss linearly with no way to recycle the funds.
